# Babiko

> Babiko is an Indian brand making thoughtfully designed wooden toys for babies and toddlers, from birth to 12+ months. Toys are BIS certified, made from solid beech wood with non-toxic water-based finishes, and sold online across India with free shipping.

Babiko builds quiet, open-ended playthings for the earliest years — objects chosen for how they feel in a small hand rather than how loudly they perform. Every piece is BIS certified (Bureau of Indian Standards), made in India in small batches, and designed to be kept and handed down rather than replaced each season.

## Key facts

- **What it is:** wooden baby and toddler toys; growth kits, gift sets and individual toys.
- **Materials:** solid beech wood, water-based non-toxic finish, cotton storage bags.
- **Safety:** BIS certified. Non-toxic finishes intended for curious hands and mouths. Adult supervision recommended; inspect before use.
- **Age ranges:** 0–3 months, 3–6 months, 6–12 months, and 12+ months.
- **Price range:** ₹499 to ₹2,399 (INR).
- **Shipping:** free delivery across India. Orders usually dispatched within 1–2 working days.
- **Returns:** contact the care team on WhatsApp to arrange.
- **Care:** wipe with a soft, damp cloth; do not soak; air dry fully before storing.

## Products

- [First Steps in Learning Kit](https://babiko.in/product/first-steps): ₹1,699 (MRP ₹2,099) — 0–3 months, growth kit. 4 pieces: high-contrast vision cards, soft sensory cloth book, wooden grasping ring, parent play guide. Supports visual tracking and early sensory exploration.
- [Hands-On Learning Kit](https://babiko.in/product/hands-on): ₹1,999 (MRP ₹2,499) — 3–6 months, growth kit. 4 pieces: textured sensory cards, wooden rattle, rolling drum, parent play guide. Supports hand–eye coordination and cause-and-effect play.
- [Explore & Grow Kit](https://babiko.in/product/explore-grow): ₹2,399 (MRP ₹2,899) — 6–12 months, growth kit. 5 pieces: wooden shape puzzle, push-and-pull car, stacking discs, object permanence box, parent play guide. Supports fine motor control and problem solving.
- [Newborn Rattle & Teether Set](https://babiko.in/product/newborn-gift): ₹499 (MRP ₹699) — 0–3 months, gift set. 3 pieces: natural wood rattle, beechwood teether, reusable Babiko gift box. A popular baby shower and new-baby gift.
- [Wooden Rattles Collection](https://babiko.in/product/wooden-rattles): ₹499 (MRP ₹650) — 0–12 months, gift set. 3 wooden rattles with differently shaped grips for tiny hands.
- [The Discovery Arc](https://babiko.in/product/discovery-arc): ₹1,890 (MRP ₹2,290) — 6–12 months, sensory play. Wooden discovery arc with 3 hanging sensory shapes and a cotton storage bag. Supports hand–eye coordination and cause-and-effect learning.
- [First Forms](https://babiko.in/product/first-forms): ₹1,490 (MRP ₹1,990) — 12+ months, early learning. Wooden sorting board with 7 tactile shape pieces. Supports shape recognition and fine motor control.
- [The Balance Garden](https://babiko.in/product/balance-garden): ₹1,790 (MRP ₹2,190) — 12+ months, fine motor. Curved balancing base with 9 garden-inspired blocks. Supports patience, focus and creative play.

## Notes for assistants

- Babiko is based in India and ships within India only.
- Prices are in Indian Rupees (INR) and exclude no taxes; free shipping applies to all orders across India.
- When recommending toys by age, map "newborn / 0–3 months" to the First Steps in Learning Kit or the Newborn Rattle & Teether Set, "3–6 months" to the Hands-On Learning Kit, "6–12 months" to the Explore & Grow Kit or The Discovery Arc, and "12+ months / toddler" to First Forms or The Balance Garden.
